text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Nakayama Festa was reading the fan 
letters she received—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Hah, look at that, Trainer. Every 
single one of them has lost their mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I read the letter handed to me. From 
children to adults, she seemed to have a 
wide range of fans, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Watching you run gets my heart pounding 
and makes me so excited!" "Make the next 
race just as thrilling!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every letter is practically bursting with 
excitement, each one begging for more 
passion and more thrills.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... Every single one of 'em's 
got their blood pumping.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hah, birds of a feather flock together, 
huh? ...Man, you guys are hopeless.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so, Nakayama Festa looked out the 
window.
choice_data_list: Wait, are you going to run now?
Wait, are you going to run now?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
We've got time, don't we? ...Besides, 
things are starting to get interesting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The high sky was dyed in a red deeper than 
orange. It almost felt like a color 
brimming with heat—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Trainer. ...Gotta show 'em 
they'll get burned if they play with fire.
